title: Unqualified harness adapter package manifest
description: Descriptive package metadata for the harness-adapter seam (R8, R10). Validation establishes the shape of an unqualified manifest and grants no execution or profile authority.

harness.description: Harness metadata. A scaffold may use an empty object.

acp.description: ACP protocol version declared by the package.

profiles_qualified.description: This schema covers packages claiming zero qualified profiles. A nonempty list requires a separately specified qualification reference and verification contract.

renders.description: Primitive classes and targets described by the render plugin. This schema checks the list container only.

render_plugin.description: Render plugin entry point. An unimplemented package may leave it empty.

state_redirect.description: Whether harness-native state honors the member private root. A scaffold may leave this unknown.

session_reuse.description: Route changes the package declares compatible with session reuse. This schema checks the list container only.
